nodes.label: HQC (Hamming Quasi-Cyclic) Post-Quantum Key Encapsulation Protocol
nodes.description: Code-based key encapsulation mechanism based on the hardness of the Decisional Quasi-Cyclic Synergy Decoding problem, providing constant-time execution against quantum side-channel attacks.

nodes.label: MADAMIRA Arabic Morphological Analysis and Disambiguation Engine
nodes.description: System for morphological analysis and contextual disambiguation of Modern Standard Arabic, combining SVM and language modeling techniques for tokenization, lemmatization, and POS tagging.

nodes.label: Louvain Modularity-Based Community Detection Algorithm
nodes.description: Heuristic method for extracting community structures from large networks by greedily optimizing local modularity in two iteratively repeated phases.

nodes.label: HDT (Header Dictionary Triples) Binary RDF Representation Standard
nodes.description: Binary format for serializing RDF graph datasets using compact dictionary encoding and bit-map representations to enable high compression and fast direct querying.

nodes.label: Triton Open-Source GPU Programming Language and Compiler Engine
nodes.description: Python-based programming language and C++ compiler infrastructure for writing highly efficient custom CUDA kernels and tensor operations without explicit memory layout management.
